headline: 13-year-old boy murdered in Comilla; 2 teenagers detained
summary: Ishayat Shahriyar Apratim, son of a Comilla University teacher, was found dead in a forest after going missing with his mother's iPhone.
details: Ishayat Shahriyar Apratim, a Class 7 student at Comilla Border Guard Public School, was found dead in a forest in the Lalmai Hills area of Sananda village on Saturday.
The boy had gone missing on Friday afternoon after leaving his rented house in the Kotbari area, reportedly taking his mother's iPhone with him to take photos with friends.
Police and local sources reported that Apratim's body bore signs of severe head injuries. The iPhone he had with him has not yet been recovered.
District Detective Branch (DB) and Special Response Battalion (SRB) police have detained two 17-year-old teenagers in connection with the murder.

Comilla University has declared a general holiday on Sunday, suspending all classes and examinations as a mark of respect for the boy, who was the only son of Associate Professor Nahida Begum of the Bengali department.
The first funeral prayer will be held at the Comilla University central field on Sunday morning, followed by a second prayer and burial near his residence in the Gandamoti area.
caption:
A 13-year-old boy was found dead in a forest after going missing with an iPhone. Two teenagers have been detained.

Ishayat Shahriyar Apratim, a Class 7 student at Comilla Border Guard Public School, was found dead in a forest in the Lalmai Hills area of Sananda village on Saturday.

The boy had gone missing on Friday afternoon after leaving his rented house in the Kotbari area, reportedly taking his mother's iPhone with him to take photos with friends.

Police and local sources reported that Apratim's body bore signs of severe head injuries. The iPhone he had with him has not yet been recovered.

District Detective Branch (DB) and Special Response Battalion (SRB) police have detained two 17-year-old teenagers in connection with the murder.

Comilla University has declared a general holiday on Sunday, suspending all classes and examinations as a mark of respect for the boy, who was the only son of Associate Professor Nahida Begum of the Bengali department.

The first funeral prayer will be held at the Comilla University central field on Sunday morning, followed by a second prayer and burial near his residence in the Gandamoti area.

headline: 3 vehicles set on fire across Dhaka this evening
summary: Incidents occurred in Mirpur, Badda, and Keraniganj, targeting a pickup and two buses.
details: Three vehicles were set on fire in separate incidents across Dhaka this evening, including two buses and a seized pickup truck.
In Mirpur-1, miscreants set fire to an Ovijat Paribahan bus around 7:00 pm. The fire was extinguished before it could spread further.
Around 7:50 pm, a staff bus of Alif Enterprise was set on fire in Middle Badda. The vehicle had been parked at the U-loop opposite the Canadian University of Bangladesh for repairs.
In Keraniganj, a seized pickup was set on fire outside the South Keraniganj Police Station around 9:25 pm, according to duty officer Ayesha Siddiqua.
Police from Mirpur Model, Badda, and South Keraniganj stations are investigating the incidents. Efforts are underway to identify the perpetrators involved in the arson attacks.
caption:

Around 7:50 pm, a staff bus of Alif Enterprise was set on fire in Middle Badda. The vehicle had been parked at the U-loop opposite the Canadian University of Bangladesh for repairs.

In Keraniganj, a seized pickup was set on fire outside the South Keraniganj Police Station around 9:25 pm, according to duty officer Ayesha Siddiqua.

Police from Mirpur Model, Badda, and South Keraniganj stations are investigating the incidents. Efforts are underway to identify the perpetrators involved in the arson attacks.
